measurements.host_scope: available RAM, swap occupancy/activity, memory+IO pressure, global CPU, load, thermal/frequency and workload process CPU deltas

measurements.prompt_tokenization_ms: separate /tokenize request before replay; not included in generation latency
measurements.server_stage_timings: record only final-event fields actually emitted by this llama.cpp build

active_q25_service.handling: record resident service and CPU deltas; never stop; report overlap

q4_k_m.provenance: requantized from the pinned Q8_0 artifact using llama.cpp; not F16-to-Q4

purpose: CPU-only runtime latency, memory, and actual prompt-cache reuse diagnostic; not a quality evaluation

replay.actual_terminal_rule: only runtime stop_type eos or word with truncated != true; cutoff/cancel/EOF are invalid, never repaired
replay.cache_evidence: record llama.cpp final-event tokens_cached and tokens_evaluated; cache_prompt=true alone is not reuse evidence
replay.input_plus_output_rule: input_tokens + 512 must be <= 3072; fail before generation, never truncate or context shift
replay.input_tokens: actual /tokenize result per fixture; no tokenizer substitution
replay.repeat_equality: compare raw UTF-8 output hashes between the primary and its immediately following exact same-prompt repeat
replay.transition_definition: distinct frozen source-state prompts sequenced through one slot; not live editor trajectories

runtime.execution_topology: one local loopback llama-server process per precision, sequential; process group owned and stopped by runner
